title: Runtime adaptive thresholds for autonomous rollback and staggered shadowing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: implement a runtime component and orchestration patterns that enable autonomous rollback decisions and a staggered (time-phased) shadowing strategy while preserving region/tier-aware routing and model-variant compatibility checks. Motivation: current rollouts rely on static thresholds and manual intervention when regressions appear; we want to reduce time-to-detect and remediate regressions while keeping risk low for production traffic. Scope: (1) a lightweight 'rollback-decider' service that consumes latency/error/quality signals and produces routing directives (traffic-weight overrides, degrade-to-variant, or auto-rollback), (2) a staggered shadowing controller that can progressively increase shadow traffic to new variants with rate/weight caps per-region and per-capacity-tier, and (3) compatibility and schema probes that run before and during shadowing to detect tokenization/schema mismatches and KV-cache regression hazards.
acceptance_criteria: Rollback-decider emits a revert directive when composite score crosses threshold and auto-revert is enabled
Staggered shadowing profile supports time-phased increases (0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20%) configurable per-region and per-tier
Routing honors region failover: canary traffic limited to primary region, shadow-only to secondary without affecting latency SLOs
Compatibility probes detect mismatched response schema or tokenization breaks and mark variant as incompatible before routing live traffic
End-to-end tests and load test show rollback decision latency < 30s from metric breach to action under normal conditions
Runbook and console UI show clear indicators and an opt-out button for automated rollback
implementation_notes: Introduce a new stateless service 'rollback-decider' that subscribes to metrics from metrics-ingest and trace-aggregator and evaluates a weighted composite of p95 latency, 99th error-rate, semantic-eval-delta, and cost-spike delta
Composite scoring formula: score = w1*latency_z + w2*error_rate_z + w3*eval_delta_norm + w4*cost_spike_norm (weights configurable via feature flag)
Decision hysteresis: require sustained breach for 3 evaluation windows (window=20s) before action unless critical errors > 5% in a single window
Actions: no-op, scale-back-weights (reduce new-variant weight by X%), degrade-to-compatible-variant tag, full-rollback (set active variant back to previous stable), notify on-call
Staggered shadowing controller: schedule-based weight increases with per-region and per-tier caps; supports pause/resume and abort; exposes progress telemetry to Console

Compatibility probes: run schema checks, tokenizer sampling (100 sample prompts), KV cache mismatch tests (warm-up + sample latencies), and semantic smoke tests (sanity eval using golden prompts), failures bubble as 'compat_incompatibility' flag

Router integration: router accepts ephemeral directives from rollback-decider via a signed directives API with short TTL (60s) and requires a quorum of control-plane replicas to apply critical revert actions
Safety net: all auto-revert actions record an immutable event with rollback reason and snapshot of routing config; Console can force-lock to prevent auto actions for an org
Telemetry: create dashboard 'Rollout Safetyboard' with composite score, contributing signals, recent directives, and per-region shadow progress
Feature-flag rollout: start with canary users=redwood-internal only, then orgs opted-in to 'auto-revert' flag; default for public is manual review
testing_plan: Unit tests for scoring logic + decision hysteresis
Integration test: rollback-decider + router in staging with simulated metric generator (latency/error/semantic loss)
Chaos test: induce region partition and verify tiered failover keeps critical routes on stable variants
E2E canary on internal org then opt-in customers with manual approval flow
Load test to validate decision latency under 10k rps mixed traffic
rollout_plan: Phase 0: merge design doc and API contract (owners: infra + runtime)
Phase 1: deploy rollback-decider in staging with read-only directives; run synthetic probes for 2 weeks
Phase 2: enable staggered shadowing controller for internal orgs only, collect metrics and refine weights
Phase 3: open opt-in for select customers with 'auto-revert=false' by default
Phase 4: enable auto-revert behind org-level feature flag and SLO hard limits
Phase 5: global rollout with Console UI controls and off-switch runbook
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: false positives from noisy metrics cause unnecessary rollbacks; Mitigation: multi-signal composite with hysteresis and manual override
Risk: rollback-decider becomes a single point of failure; Mitigation: make actions idempotent, sign directives, require quorum, and fallback to manual if control-plane unavailable
Risk: shadow traffic causes hidden cost spikes in Dedicated customers; Mitigation: enforce per-tenant cost caps and do not shadow on dedicated-only routes unless explicitly enabled
Risk: incompatibility semantics missed by probes (eg. edge-case tokenization); Mitigation: increase probe sample diversity and integrate semantic regression evals before phase increases
notes: Design review scheduled: 2026-02-28 -> feedback from PM and Security: prefer opt-in auto-revert for enterprise accounts; add KMS-signed directives requirement for private deployments
PR feedback (GH#312): runtime change needs an interface shim to avoid hot restarts of router instances; prefer config hot-reload with gradual apply
Follow-up tasks: add console affordance for 'pause auto-revert' per-organization and 'simulate directive' button for infra debugging
On-call paging: create escalation policy for rollback events routed to SRE-runbook 'ROLLBACK-AUTO'
